# Issue templates

Choose the template that best matches the report. Titles and field labels are
in English for international search; contributors may write submissions in
English or German.

| Template | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [Bug report](bug_report.yml) | Reproduction steps and expected behavior. |
| [Feature request](feature_request.yml) | User problem, outcome, scope, and evidence. |
| [Documentation issue](documentation.yml) | Missing, incorrect, or stale documentation. |
| [Knowledge gap](knowledge_gap.yml) | Source/claim gaps and review requirements. |
| [Music theory review](music_theory_review.yml) | Bounded review of a musical claim or behavior. |
| [Localization](localization.yml) | UI, CLI, documentation, or learning-content translation. |
| [Research task](research_task.yml) | Source-aware, bounded research. |
| [Technical debt](technical_debt.yml) | Maintainability and compatibility work. |
| [Accessibility issue](accessibility.yml) | Accessibility barriers and acceptance criteria. |

Security vulnerabilities must use the private reporting route in
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md), not a public issue.
